```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(here)
library(geosphere)
library(SDLfilter)

source(here::here("code", "_shared.R"))
ensure_project_dirs()
```

# Settings and helper functions

```{r settings, include=FALSE}
OUTPUT_PATHS <- c(
  gps_combined = here::here("outputs", "GPS_combined.csv"),
  gps_filtered = here::here("outputs", "filtered.csv"),
  gps_resampled = here::here("outputs", "resampling.csv"),
  trip_segmentation = here::here("outputs", "trip_segmentation.csv")
)

LOGGER_PATHS <- list(
  axy = c(
    "2024" = here::here("rawdata", "2024_Axy"),
    "2025" = here::here("rawdata", "2025_Axy")
  ),
  vhf = here::here("rawdata", "2025_VHF"),
  gipsy = here::here("rawdata", "2025_Gipsy")
)

GPS_FILTER <- list(
  max_speed_kmh = 90,
  qi = 4,
  inner_angle_deg = 90,
  method = 2,
  lat_range = c(38, 42),
  lon_range = c(140, 145)
)

TRIP_RULE <- list(
  nest = unname(NEST_COORDS),
  distance_m = 1000,
  duration_s = 60 * 60
)

write_csv_jst <- function(data, path) {
  data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      time = format(
        lubridate::with_tz(time, LOCAL_TZ),
        format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
        tz = LOCAL_TZ
      )
    ) %>%
    readr::write_csv(path)
}

parse_axy_time <- function(date, time) {
  timestamp <- paste(date, time)
  formats <- c(
    "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S",
    "%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S",
    "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
  )

  parsed <- strptime(timestamp, formats[[1]], tz = "UTC")
  for (format_i in formats[-1]) {
    if (!all(is.na(parsed))) break
    parsed <- strptime(timestamp, format_i, tz = "UTC")
  }

  lubridate::with_tz(as.POSIXct(parsed), LOCAL_TZ)
}

read_axy_file <- function(file, year) {
  data <- readr::read_table(
    file,
    col_names = FALSE,
    skip_empty_rows = FALSE,
    col_types = readr::cols(
      X1 = "c",
      X2 = "c",
      X3 = "n",
      X4 = "n"
    )
  ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::select(X1:X4)

  tibble::tibble(
    time = parse_axy_time(data$X1, data$X2),
    lon = data$X4,
    lat = data$X3,
    id = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file)),
    year = as.numeric(year),
    logger = "Axy"
  )
}

read_vhf_file <- function(file) {
  data <- readr::read_table(
    file,
    col_names = FALSE,
    skip = 1,
    col_types = readr::cols(
      X4 = "c",
      X5 = "c",
      X9 = "n",
      X10 = "n"
    )
  ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::select(X4, X5, X9, X10)

  tibble::tibble(
    time = strptime(
      paste(data$X4, data$X5),
      "%y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S",
      tz = "UTC"
    ) %>%
      as.POSIXct() %>%
      lubridate::with_tz(LOCAL_TZ),
    lon = data$X10,
    lat = data$X9,
    id = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file)),
    year = 2025,
    logger = "VHF"
  )
}

read_gipsy_file <- function(file) {
  read.table(
    file,
    sep = "",
    header = TRUE,
    fill = TRUE
  )[, 1:6]
}

rle_sections <- function(x) {
  encoded <- rle(x)
  ends <- cumsum(encoded$lengths)

  data.frame(
    value = encoded$values,
    length = encoded$lengths,
    start = ends - encoded$lengths + 1,
    stop = ends
  )
}

assign_trip_ids <- function(data, distance_m, duration_s) {
  nest_out <- as.numeric(data$Nest_Distance > distance_m)
  candidate <- rle_sections(nest_out) %>%
    dplyr::filter(value == 1)

  trip_id <- rep(0, nrow(data))
  if (nrow(candidate) == 0) return(trip_id)

  duration <- as.numeric(
    difftime(
      data$time[candidate$stop],
      data$time[candidate$start],
      units = "secs"
    )
  )
  trips <- candidate[duration > duration_s, ]
  if (nrow(trips) == 0) return(trip_id)

  # A run that reaches the final GPS fix has no observed return to the nest.
  if (trips$stop[nrow(trips)] == nrow(data)) {
    trips <- trips[-nrow(trips), , drop = FALSE]
  }
  if (nrow(trips) == 0) return(trip_id)

  for (j in seq_len(nrow(trips))) {
    trip_id[trips$start[j]:trips$stop[j]] <- j
  }
  trip_id
}
```

# Data input

## Axy-Trek

```{r read-axy}
axy_all <- purrr::imap_dfr(LOGGER_PATHS$axy, function(directory, year) {
  files <- list.files(
    path = directory,
    pattern = "\\.txt$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  purrr::map_dfr(files, read_axy_file, year = year)
}) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(id, time)
```

## PinPoint VHF

```{r read-vhf}
vhf_all <- list.files(
  path = LOGGER_PATHS$vhf,
  pattern = "\\.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
) %>%
  purrr::map_dfr(read_vhf_file) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na() %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    # Equivalent to 2025-06-01 00:00:00 UTC.
    time < as.POSIXct("2025-06-01 09:00:00", tz = LOCAL_TZ)
  )
```

## Gipsy Remote

```{r read-gipsy}
gipsy_all <- list.files(
  path = LOGGER_PATHS$gipsy,
  pattern = "\\.txt$",
  full.names = TRUE
) %>%
  purrr::map_dfr(read_gipsy_file) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("^([^/]*?/){2}[^/]*$", Name)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    time = as.POSIXct(
      paste(address, Timestamp),
      format = "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S",
      tz = "UTC"
    ) %>%
      lubridate::with_tz(LOCAL_TZ)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    time >= as.POSIXct("2025-05-12 10:00:00", tz = LOCAL_TZ),
    time <= as.POSIXct("2025-05-29 07:30:00", tz = LOCAL_TZ),
    as.numeric(Latitude) > 38,
    as.numeric(Latitude) < 42
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    time,
    lon = as.numeric(Longitude),
    lat = as.numeric(Latitude),
    id = Name,
    year = 2025,
    logger = "Gipsy"
  )
```

## Combine logger types

```{r combine-loggers}
data_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(axy_all, vhf_all, gipsy_all) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(id, time)

write_csv_jst(data_all, OUTPUT_PATHS[["gps_combined"]])
```

# Outlier removal

```{r outlier-removal}
data_all_clean <- data_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    lat >= GPS_FILTER$lat_range[[1]],
    lat <= GPS_FILTER$lat_range[[2]],
    lon >= GPS_FILTER$lon_range[[1]],
    lon <= GPS_FILTER$lon_range[[2]]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Time = lubridate::with_tz(time, LOCAL_TZ),
    qi = 10
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(DateTime = time) %>%
  as.data.frame()

data_filtered <- SDLfilter::ddfilter(
  data_all_clean,
  vmax = GPS_FILTER$max_speed_kmh,
  qi = GPS_FILTER$qi,
  ia = GPS_FILTER$inner_angle_deg,
  method = GPS_FILTER$method
)

cat("Removed", nrow(data_all_clean) - nrow(data_filtered), "points\n")

data_filtered <- as.data.frame(data_filtered) %>%
  dplyr::rename(time = DateTime) %>%
  dplyr::select(time, lon, lat, id, year, logger)

summary(data_filtered[, c("lat", "lon")])
head(data_filtered)

write_csv_jst(data_filtered, OUTPUT_PATHS[["gps_filtered"]])
```

# Deployment-period filtering

```{r deployment-periods}
data_filtered <- data_filtered %>%
  dplyr::mutate(time = lubridate::with_tz(as.POSIXct(time), LOCAL_TZ))

periods <- list(
  "62206" = c("2025-05-11 14:55:00", "2025-06-01 00:00:00"),
  "62207" = c("2025-05-11 15:26:00", "2025-06-01 00:00:00"),
  "671" = c("2025-05-12 09:28:00", "2025-05-23 09:53:00"),
  "675" = c("2025-05-14 10:07:00", "2025-06-01 00:00:00"),
  "681" = c("2025-05-16 10:39:00", "2025-06-01 00:00:00"),
  "683" = c("2025-05-14 14:48:00", "2025-06-01 00:00:00"),
  "685" = c("2025-05-14 15:51:00", "2025-05-26 15:15:00"),
  "BTG_KAB_2025_9B01831_S1" = c("2025-05-11 10:35:00", "2025-05-19 11:37:00"),
  "BTG_KAB_2025_9B03427_S1" = c("2025-05-09 14:07:00", "2025-05-19 11:22:00"),
  "BTG_KAB_2025_9B40989_S2" = c("2025-05-09 14:50:00", "2025-05-23 09:35:00"),
  "ATK_29B_S1" = c("2024-05-09 14:40:00", "2024-05-14 14:52:00"),
  "ATK_2B_S1" = c("2024-05-09 13:57:00", "2024-05-15 10:12:00"),
  "ATK_6E_S1" = c("2024-05-09 13:19:00", "2024-05-15 10:47:00")
)

df_all_filter <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(periods), function(id_i) {
  period <- periods[[id_i]]
  start_jst <- as.POSIXct(period[[1]], tz = LOCAL_TZ)
  end_jst <- as.POSIXct(period[[2]], tz = LOCAL_TZ)

  if (is.na(start_jst) || is.na(end_jst)) return(NULL)

  data_filtered %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      id == id_i,
      time >= start_jst,
      time <= end_jst
    )
}))
```

# Five-minute resampling

```{r resampling}
df_all_5min <- df_all_filter %>%
  dplyr::mutate(time_5min = lubridate::floor_date(time, unit = "5 minutes"))

df_all_filter <- df_all_filter %>%
  dplyr::arrange(id, time) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    time_diff_sec = as.numeric(difftime(time, dplyr::lag(time), units = "secs"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

df_all_thinned <- df_all_5min %>%
  dplyr::arrange(id, time_5min, time) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id, time_5min) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

df_all_thin <- df_all_thinned %>%
  dplyr::mutate(time = time_5min) %>%
  dplyr::select(-time_5min) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(id, time) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    time_diff_sec = as.numeric(difftime(time, dplyr::lag(time), units = "secs"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

df_all_thin %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_time_diff_sec = mean(time_diff_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = stats::sd(time_diff_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv_jst(df_all_thin, OUTPUT_PATHS[["gps_resampled"]])
```

# Trip segmentation

```{r trip-segmentation}
data_out_all <- df_all_thin %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Nest_Distance = geosphere::distGeo(
      matrix(TRIP_RULE$nest, nrow = dplyr::n(), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE),
      cbind(lon, lat)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

out_data <- tibble::tibble()

for (id_i in unique(data_out_all$id)) {
  data <- data_out_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(id == id_i)

  data$Trip_ID <- assign_trip_ids(
    data,
    distance_m = TRIP_RULE$distance_m,
    duration_s = TRIP_RULE$duration_s
  )

  out_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(out_data, data)
}

out_data_clean <- out_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(Trip_ID != 0)

out_data_clean %>%
  dplyr::group_by(id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_trip = dplyr::n_distinct(Trip_ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv_jst(out_data_clean, OUTPUT_PATHS[["trip_segmentation"]])
```
